translations.kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
translations.ylt: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we did behold, and our hands did handle, concerning the Word of the Life--
translations.web: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

translations.kjv: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
translations.ylt: and the Life was manifested, and we have seen, and do testify, and declare to you the Life, the age-during, which was with the Father, and was manifested to us--
translations.web: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

translations.kjv: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: that which we have seen and heard declare we to you, that ye also may have fellowship with us, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with His Son Jesus Christ;
translations.web: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
translations.ylt: and these things we write to you, that your joy may be full.
translations.web: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

translations.kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
translations.ylt: And this is the message that we have heard from Him, and announce to you, that God is light, and darkness in Him is not at all;
translations.web: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

translations.kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
translations.ylt: if we may say--`we have fellowship with Him,' and in the darkness may walk--we lie, and do not the truth;
translations.web: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

translations.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
translations.ylt: and if in the light we may walk, as He is in the light--we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ His Son doth cleanse us from every sin;
translations.web: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

translations.kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
translations.ylt: if we may say--`we have not sin,' ourselves we lead astray, and the truth is not in us;
translations.web: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

translations.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
translations.ylt: if we may confess our sins, stedfast He is and righteous that He may forgive us the sins, and may cleanse us from every unrighteousness;
translations.web: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

translations.kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
translations.ylt: if we may say--`we have not sinned,' a liar we make Him, and His word is not in us.
translations.web: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

translations.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
translations.ylt: My little children, these things I write to you, that ye may not sin: and if any one may sin, an advocate we have with the Father, Jesus Christ, a righteous one,
translations.web: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

translations.kjv: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
translations.ylt: and he--he is a propitiation for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world,
translations.web: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

translations.kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
translations.ylt: and in this we know that we have known him, if his commands we may keep;
translations.web: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

translations.kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
translations.ylt: he who is saying, `I have known him,' and his command is not keeping, a liar he is, and in him the truth is not;
translations.web: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

translations.kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
translations.ylt: and whoever may keep his word, truly in him the love of God hath been perfected; in this we know that in him we are.
translations.web: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

translations.kjv: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
translations.ylt: He who is saying in him he doth remain, ought according as he walked also himself so to walk.
translations.web: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

translations.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
translations.ylt: Brethren, a new command I write not to you, but an old command, that ye had from the beginning--the old command is the word that ye heard from the beginning;
translations.web: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

translations.kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
translations.ylt: again, a new command I write to you, which thing is true in him and in you, because the darkness doth pass away, and the true light doth now shine;
translations.web: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

translations.kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
translations.ylt: he who is saying, in the light he is, and his brother is hating, in the darkness he is till now;
translations.web: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

translations.kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
translations.ylt: he who is loving his brother, in the light he doth remain, and a stumbling-block in him there is not;
translations.web: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

translations.kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
translations.ylt: and he who is hating his brother, in the darkness he is, and in the darkness he doth walk, and he hath not known whither he doth go, because the darkness did blind his eyes.
translations.web: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

translations.kjv: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
translations.ylt: I write to you, little children, because the sins have been forgiven you through his name;
translations.web: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

translations.kjv: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
translations.ylt: I write to you, fathers, because ye have known him who is from the beginning; I write to you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil. I write to you, little youths, because ye have known the Father:
translations.web: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

translations.kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
translations.ylt: I did write to you, fathers, because ye have known him who is from the beginning; I did write to you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God in you doth remain, and ye have overcome the evil.
translations.web: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

translations.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
translations.ylt: Love not ye the world, nor the things in the world; if any one doth love the world, the love of the Father is not in him,
translations.web: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

translations.kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
translations.ylt: because all that is in the world--the desire of the flesh, and the desire of the eyes, and the ostentation of the life--is not of the Father, but of the world,
translations.web: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

translations.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
translations.ylt: and the world doth pass away, and the desire of it, and he who is doing the will of God, he doth remain--to the age.
translations.web: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

translations.kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
translations.ylt: Little youths, it is the last hour; and even as ye heard that the antichrist doth come, even now antichrists have become many--whence we know that it is the last hour;
translations.web: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

translations.kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
translations.ylt: out of us they went forth, but they were not of us, for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us; but--that they might be manifested that they are not all of us.
translations.web: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

translations.kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
translations.ylt: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and have known all things;
translations.web: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

translations.kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
translations.ylt: I did not write to you because ye have not known the truth, but because ye have known it, and because no lie is of the truth.
translations.web: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

translations.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
translations.ylt: Who is the liar, except he who is denying that Jesus is the Christ? this one is the antichrist who is denying the Father and the Son;
translations.web: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

translations.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
translations.ylt: every one who is denying the Son, neither hath he the Father, he who is confessing the Son hath the Father also.
translations.web: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

translations.kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
translations.ylt: Ye, then, that which ye heard from the beginning, in you let it remain; if in you may remain that which from the beginning ye did hear, ye also in the Son and in the Father shall remain,
translations.web: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

translations.kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
translations.ylt: and this is the promise that He did promise us--the life the age-during.
translations.web: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

translations.kjv: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
translations.ylt: These things I did write to you concerning those leading you astray;
translations.web: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

translations.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
translations.ylt: and you, the anointing that ye did receive from him, in you it doth remain, and ye have no need that any one may teach you, but as the same anointing doth teach you concerning all, and is true, and is not a lie, and even as was taught you, ye shall remain in him.
translations.web: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

translations.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
translations.ylt: And now, little children, remain in him, that when he may be manifested, we may have boldness, and may not be ashamed before him, in his presence;
translations.web: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

translations.kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
translations.ylt: if ye know that he is righteous, know ye that every one doing the righteousness, of him hath been begotten.
translations.web: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

translations.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
translations.ylt: See ye what love the Father hath given to us, that children of God we may be called; because of this the world doth not know us, because it did not know Him;
translations.web: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

translations.kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
translations.ylt: beloved, now, children of God are we, and it was not yet manifested what we shall be, and we have known that if he may be manifested, like him we shall be, because we shall see him as he is;
translations.web: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

translations.kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
translations.ylt: and every one who is having this hope on him, doth purify himself, even as he is pure.
translations.web: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

translations.kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
translations.ylt: Every one who is doing the sin, the lawlessness also he doth do, and the sin is the lawlessness,
translations.web: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

translations.kjv: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
translations.ylt: and ye have known that he was manifested that our sins he may take away, and sin is not in him;
translations.web: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

translations.kjv: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
translations.ylt: every one who is remaining in him doth not sin; every one who is sinning, hath not seen him, nor known him.
translations.web: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

translations.kjv: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
translations.ylt: Little children, let no one lead you astray; he who is doing the righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous,
translations.web: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

translations.kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
translations.ylt: he who is doing the sin, of the devil he is, because from the beginning the devil doth sin; for this was the Son of God manifested, that he may break up the works of the devil;
translations.web: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

translations.kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
translations.ylt: every one who hath been begotten of God, sin he doth not, because his seed in him doth remain, and he is not able to sin, because of God he hath been begotten.
translations.web: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

translations.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
translations.ylt: In this manifest are the children of God, and the children of the devil; every one who is not doing righteousness, is not of God, and he who is not loving his brother,
translations.web: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

translations.kjv: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
translations.ylt: because this is the message that ye did hear from the beginning, that we may love one another,
translations.web: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

translations.kjv: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
translations.ylt: not as Cain--of the evil one he was, and he did slay his brother, and wherefore did he slay him? because his works were evil, and those of his brother righteous.
translations.web: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

translations.kjv: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
translations.ylt: Do not wonder, my brethren, if the world doth hate you;
translations.web: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

translations.kjv: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
translations.ylt: we--we have known that we have passed out of the death to the life, because we love the brethren; he who is not loving the brother doth remain in the death.
translations.web: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

translations.kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
translations.ylt: Every one who is hating his brother--a man-killer he is, and ye have known that no man-killer hath life age-during in him remaining,
translations.web: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

translations.kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
translations.ylt: in this we have known the love, because he for us his life did lay down, and we ought for the brethren the lives to lay down;
translations.web: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

translations.kjv: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
translations.ylt: and whoever may have the goods of the world, and may view his brother having need, and may shut up his bowels from him--how doth the love of God remain in him?
translations.web: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

translations.kjv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
translations.ylt: My little children, may we not love in word nor in tongue, but in word and in truth!
translations.web: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

translations.kjv: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
translations.ylt: and in this we know that of the truth we are, and before Him we shall assure our hearts,
translations.web: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

translations.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
translations.ylt: because if our heart may condemn--because greater is God than our heart, and He doth know all things.
translations.web: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

translations.kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
translations.ylt: Beloved, if our heart may not condemn us, we have boldness toward God,
translations.web: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

translations.kjv: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
translations.ylt: and whatever we may ask, we receive from Him, because His commands we keep, and the things pleasing before Him we do,
translations.web: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

translations.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
translations.ylt: and this is His command, that we may believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and may love one another, even as He did give command to us,
translations.web: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

translations.kjv: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
translations.ylt: and he who is keeping His commands, in Him he doth remain, and He in him; and in this we know that He doth remain in us, from the Spirit that He gave us.
translations.web: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

translations.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
translations.ylt: Beloved, every spirit believe not, but prove the spirits, if of God they are, because many false prophets have gone forth to the world;
translations.web: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

translations.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
translations.ylt: in this know ye the Spirit of God; every spirit that doth confess Jesus Christ in the flesh having come, of God it is,
translations.web: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

translations.kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
translations.ylt: and every spirit that doth not confess Jesus Christ in the flesh having come, of God it is not; and this is that of the antichrist, which ye heard that it doth come, and now in the world it is already.
translations.web: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

translations.kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
translations.ylt: Ye--of God ye are, little children, and ye have overcome them; because greater is He who is in you, than he who is in the world.
translations.web: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

translations.kjv: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
translations.ylt: They--of the world they are; because of this from the world they speak, and the world doth hear them;
translations.web: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

translations.kjv: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
translations.ylt: we--of God we are; he who is knowing God doth hear us; he who is not of God, doth not hear us; from this we know the spirit of the truth, and the spirit of the error.
translations.web: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

translations.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
translations.ylt: Beloved, may we love one another, because the love is of God, and every one who is loving, of God he hath been begotten, and doth know God;
translations.web: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

translations.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
translations.ylt: he who is not loving did not know God, because God is love.
translations.web: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

translations.kjv: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
translations.ylt: In this was manifested the love of God in us, because His Son--the only begotten--hath God sent to the world, that we may live through him;
translations.web: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

translations.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
translations.ylt: in this is the love, not that we loved God, but that He did love us, and did send His Son a propitiation for our sins.
translations.web: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

translations.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
translations.ylt: Beloved, if thus did God love us, we also ought one another to love;
translations.web: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

translations.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
translations.ylt: God no one hath ever seen; if we may love one another, God in us doth remain, and His love is having been perfected in us;
translations.web: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

translations.kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
translations.ylt: in this we know that in Him we do remain, and He in us, because of His Spirit He hath given us.
translations.web: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

translations.kjv: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
translations.ylt: And we--we have seen and do testify, that the Father hath sent the Son--Saviour of the world;
translations.web: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

translations.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
translations.ylt: whoever may confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God in him doth remain, and he in God;
translations.web: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

translations.kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
translations.ylt: and we--we have known and believed the love, that God hath in us; God is love, and he who is remaining in the love, in God he doth remain, and God in him.
translations.web: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

translations.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
translations.ylt: In this made perfect hath been the love with us, that boldness we may have in the day of the judgment, because even as He is, we--we also are in this world;
translations.web: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

translations.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
translations.ylt: fear is not in the love, but the perfect love doth cast out the fear, because the fear hath punishment, and he who is fearing hath not been made perfect in the love;
translations.web: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

translations.kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.
translations.ylt: we--we love him, because He--He first loved us;
translations.web: We love him, because he first loved us.

translations.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
translations.ylt: if any one may say--`I love God,' and his brother he may hate, a liar he is; for he who is not loving his brother whom he hath seen, God--whom he hath not seen--how is he able to love?
translations.web: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

translations.kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
translations.ylt: and this is the command we have from Him, that he who is loving God, may also love his brother.
translations.web: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

translations.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
translations.ylt: Every one who is believing that Jesus is the Christ, of God he hath been begotten, and every one who is loving Him who did beget, doth love also him who is begotten of Him:
translations.web: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

translations.kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
translations.ylt: in this we know that we love the children of God, when we may love God, and His commands may keep;
translations.web: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

translations.kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
translations.ylt: for this is the love of God, that His commands we may keep, and His commands are not burdensome;
translations.web: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

translations.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
translations.ylt: because every one who is begotten of God doth overcome the world, and this is the victory that did overcome the world--our faith;
translations.web: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

translations.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
translations.ylt: who is he who is overcoming the world, if not he who is believing that Jesus is the Son of God?
translations.web: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

translations.kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
translations.ylt: This one is he who did come through water and blood--Jesus the Christ, not in the water only, but in the water and the blood; and the Spirit it is that is testifying, because the Spirit is the truth,
translations.web: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

translations.kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
translations.ylt: because three are who are testifying in the heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these--the three--are one;
translations.web: For there are three who testify:

translations.kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
translations.ylt: and three are who are testifying in the earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood, and the three are into the one.
translations.web: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

translations.kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
translations.ylt: If the testimony of men we receive, the testimony of God is greater, because this is the testimony of God that He hath testified concerning His Son.
translations.web: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

translations.kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
translations.ylt: He who is believing in the Son of God, hath the testimony in himself; he who is not believing God, a liar hath made Him, because he hath not believed in the testimony that God hath testified concerning His Son;
translations.web: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

translations.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
translations.ylt: and this is the testimony, that life age-during did God give to us, and this--the life--is in His Son;
translations.web: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

translations.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
translations.ylt: he who is having the Son, hath the life; he who is not having the Son of God--the life he hath not.
translations.web: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

translations.kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
translations.ylt: These things I did write to you who are believing in the name of the Son of God, that ye may know that life ye have age-during, and that ye may believe in the name of the Son of God.
translations.web: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

translations.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
translations.ylt: And this is the boldness that we have toward Him, that if anything we may ask according to his will, He doth hear us,
translations.web: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

translations.kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
translations.ylt: and if we have known that He doth hear us, whatever we may ask, we have known that we have the requests that we have requested from Him.
translations.web: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

translations.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
translations.ylt: If any one may see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and He shall give to him life to those sinning not unto death; there is sin to death, not concerning it do I speak that he may beseech;
translations.web: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

translations.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
translations.ylt: all unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not unto death.
translations.web: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

translations.kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
translations.ylt: We have known that every one who hath been begotten of God doth not sin, but he who was begotten of God doth keep himself, and the evil one doth not touch him;
translations.web: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

translations.kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
translations.ylt: we have known that of God we are, and the whole world in the evil doth lie;
translations.web: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

translations.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
translations.ylt: and we have known that the Son of God is come, and hath given us a mind, that we may know Him who is true, and we are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ; this one is the true God and the life age-during!
translations.web: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

translations.kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
translations.ylt: Little children, guard yourselves from the idols! Amen.
translations.web: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
